run_hydra_app_cwd_demo: run the hydra app to print current and original working directories
run_get_original_cwd: run the hydra app to retrieve the original working directory before hydra changes it
run_to_absolute_path_relative: run the hydra app to convert a relative path to an absolute path
run_to_absolute_path_absolute: run the hydra app to resolve an absolute path using to_absolute_path
review_my_app_hydra_main: review the my_app function decorated with hydra.main to understand working directory utilities
